AWS API checks (AMI, instance type offering, RDS engine version)

skipped.message: opt-in: use --aws-checks (needs AWS credentials, read-only calls)

testcase.name: [CRITICAL] IAM_FULL_ADMIN aws_iam_policy.admin (iam.tf:3)

failure.message: IAM policy grants full administrator privileges

testcase.failure:
The policy allows Action "*" on Resource "*" (or full IAM privileges).
Recommendation: Grant only the actions needed on the resources needed; start from AWS managed job-function policies or IAM Access Analyzer policy generation. Engine message: Ensure IAM policies that allow full "*-*" administrative privileges are not created

testcase.name: [HIGH] IAM_INVALID_PRINCIPAL aws_iam_role.app (iam.tf:15)
testcase.failure:
A principal does not have a valid format; IAM rejects the policy (MalformedPolicyDocument: Invalid principal in policy).
Recommendation: Use service principals like "ec2.amazonaws.com", 12-digit account IDs or full ARNs (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/name). Engine message: "ec2.amazon.com" is not a valid service principal (did you mean "ec2.amazonaws.com"?).

testcase.name: [HIGH] AWS_INVALID_INSTANCE_TYPE aws_instance.example (main.tf:3)
testcase.failure:
The specified EC2 instance type is not recognized. ("t3.invalid" is an invalid value as instance_type)
Recommendation: Verify that the instance type exists in the selected AWS region and is supported by the selected architecture and AMI: `aws ec2 describe-instance-type-offerings --location-type region --filters Name=instance-type,Values=<type> --region <region>` (or run tfpv with --aws-checks). `terraform plan` does not catch this: the error appears at apply. Engine message: "t3.invalid" is an invalid value as instance_type

testcase.name: [HIGH] EC2_AMI_ID_MALFORMED aws_instance.bad_ami (main.tf:13)
testcase.failure:
The AMI ID does not match the format ami-xxxxxxxx (8 or 17 hexadecimal characters); AWS returns InvalidAMIID.Malformed.
Recommendation: Use a real AMI ID, or resolve it with the aws_ami data source (most_recent + filters). Engine message: "ami-xyz" is not a valid AMI ID (expected ami- followed by 8 or 17 hex characters).

testcase.name: [HIGH] NET_SUBNET_OVERLAP aws_subnet.public_b (network.tf:12)
testcase.failure:
Two subnets of the same VPC have overlapping CIDR blocks; AWS rejects the second one (InvalidSubnet.Conflict).
Recommendation: Give each subnet a distinct, non-overlapping CIDR (e.g. cidrsubnet with distinct netnum values). Engine message: Subnet CIDR 10.0.1.128/25 overlaps aws_subnet.public_a (10.0.1.0/24) in aws_vpc.main.

testcase.name: [HIGH] NET_SUBNET_OUTSIDE_VPC aws_subnet.outside (network.tf:17)
testcase.failure:
The subnet CIDR is not contained in any CIDR block of its VPC; AWS rejects it (InvalidSubnet.Range). `terraform plan` does not detect it.
Recommendation: Derive subnets from the VPC CIDR (`cidrsubnet(aws_vpc.main.cidr_block, 8, n)`) or associate a secondary CIDR (aws_vpc_ipv4_cidr_block_association). Engine message: Subnet CIDR 10.1.0.0/24 is not inside the CIDR block(s) of aws_vpc.main (10.0.0.0/16).

testcase.name: [HIGH] SG_PORT_RANGE_INVALID aws_security_group.web (network.tf:32)
testcase.failure:
from_port is greater than to_port, or a port is outside 0-65535.
Recommendation: Use from_port <= to_port within 0-65535 (for a single port, set both to the same value). Engine message: Invalid port range from_port=443 to_port=80 for protocol tcp.

testcase.name: [HIGH] TF_UNDECLARED_REFERENCE aws_route_table.rt (network.tf:47)
testcase.failure:
An expression references a resource, data source, variable, local or module that is not declared in this module. Terraform says: A managed resource "aws_vpc" "mian" has not been declared in the root module.
Recommendation: Fix the name or declare the object. Objects of other modules are only reachable through their outputs (module.<name>.<output>). Engine message: Reference to undeclared resource

testcase.name: [HIGH] EBS_SIZE_BELOW_MINIMUM aws_ebs_volume.logs (storage.tf:7)

failure.message: Volume smaller than the minimum size

testcase.failure:
The volume size is below the minimum for its type (st1/sc1: 125 GiB, io1/io2: 4 GiB, gp2/gp3/standard: 1 GiB).
Recommendation: Increase the size to at least the minimum for the type, or change the type. Engine message: Volume size 50 GiB is below the 125 GiB minimum for "st1".

testcase.name: [HIGH] EBS_IOPS_NOT_SUPPORTED aws_ebs_volume.logs (storage.tf:9)

failure.message: iops set on a volume type that does not support it

testcase.failure:
Provisioned IOPS can only be set for io1, io2 and gp3 volumes; for this type the AWS provider fails the plan ("'iops' must not be set when 'type' is ...").
Recommendation: Remove `iops`, or switch the volume to gp3/io1/io2. Engine message: iops is set but volume type "st1" does not support provisioned IOPS.

testcase.name: [HIGH] RDS_MAX_STORAGE_BELOW_ALLOCATED aws_db_instance.db (storage.tf:18)
testcase.failure:
Storage autoscaling requires max_allocated_storage to be greater than allocated_storage; AWS rejects the value.
Recommendation: Set max_allocated_storage above allocated_storage, or to 0 to disable autoscaling. Engine message: max_allocated_storage (50) is lower than allocated_storage (100).

testcase.name: [HIGH] RDS_IOPS_STORAGE_TYPE_CONFLICT aws_db_instance.db (storage.tf:20)

failure.message: iops incompatible with the storage type

testcase.failure:
Provisioned IOPS are not supported with gp2/standard storage, and are required for io1/io2.
Recommendation: Use storage_type io1/io2/gp3 with iops, or remove iops for gp2/standard. Engine message: iops is set but storage_type "gp2" does not support provisioned IOPS.

testcase.name: [HIGH] RDS_MULTI_AZ_WITH_AZ aws_db_instance.db (storage.tf:22)
testcase.failure:
A specific availability zone cannot be requested for a Multi-AZ instance (InvalidParameterCombination).
Recommendation: Remove availability_zone when multi_az = true. Engine message: multi_az = true cannot be combined with availability_zone.

testcase.name: [HIGH] TF_VARIABLE_TYPE_MISMATCH var.instance_count (terraform.tfvars:1)

failure.message: Variable value does not match its type

testcase.failure:
The value assigned to the variable cannot be converted to the declared type constraint; `terraform validate` does not check variable values.
Recommendation: Assign a value of the declared type, or change the type constraint if the value is the intended one. Engine message: Invalid value for variable "instance_count" in terraform.tfvars: a number is required, got string 'three' (declared type: number, in variables.tf:11).

testcase.name: [HIGH] TF_MISSING_VARIABLE_VALUE var.environment (variables.tf:20)
testcase.failure:
The variable has no default and no value was found in terraform.tfvars, *.auto.tfvars, the --var-file/--var options or TF_VAR_ environment variables.
Recommendation: Provide the value (tfvars file, `-var-file`, or `TF_VAR_<name>` in CI) or add a default. With `-input=false`, plan fails with "No value for required variable". If the value is passed at runtime, give the same file to tfpv with --var-file. Engine message: Variable "environment" has no default and no value is provided (tfvars, --var-file, --var, TF_VAR_environment).

testcase.name: [MEDIUM] SG_ALL_PROTOCOL_WITH_PORTS aws_security_group.web (network.tf:39)
testcase.failure:
With protocol "-1" (all traffic), from_port and to_port must both be 0; the rule otherwise does not do what it says (all ports are opened) and the AWS provider rejects it.
Recommendation: Set protocol to "tcp"/"udp" for a port range, or set from_port = 0 and to_port = 0 with protocol "-1". Engine message: protocol "-1" (all traffic) with from_port=22 and to_port=22: all ports are opened, not the ones written, and the provider expects 0/0.
